members.acceptance: Implement and validate a versioned multi-root execution-envelope/publication contract that independently allowlists product-root and state-root paths, preserves single-root compatibility, rejects missing paths, traversal, symlink or wrong-root paths, and prevents publication outside the declared root. Add positive and negative offline tests for both roots and exact publication scope; preserve existing lifecycle, identity, command, evidence, and gate boundaries.
members.ownership: Coordinator execution-envelope and publication-scope repair only; own the product-root/state-root path contract and tests while preserving AR-0092 evidence and all existing gates.
members.scope: Repair execution-envelope path and publication scope for independent product-root and state-root execution. Add only the narrowly scoped multi-root contract and its validation/tests, retain single-root behavior, and fail closed on missing, traversal, symlink, wrong-root, or widened publication paths.
